dataset_column.age_band: Age band of the published scoring profile at freeze time.
dataset_column.age_months: Age at the session, in whole months.
dataset_column.label: Label value, for example the signed review’s disposition.
dataset_column.participant_pseudonym: Participant pseudonym, stable within this dataset only.
dataset_column.reviewer_pseudonym: Reviewer pseudonym, stable within this dataset only.
dataset_column.split: Split part: train, validation or holdout.
flag_assessment.differs.detail: Share this result with your pediatrician at the next visit. This is a screening signal, not a diagnosis.
flag_assessment.differs.headline: Looking differs from the age reference
flag_assessment.matches.detail: Looking time sits in the expected range for this age. This is a screening signal, not a diagnosis.
flag_assessment.matches.headline: Looking matches the age reference
flag_assessment.no_scored_clips.detail: Run a full stimulus set before reading a flag. This is a screening signal, not a diagnosis.
flag_assessment.no_scored_clips.headline: Not enough scored clips
flag_assessment.some_differ.detail: A repeat session is worth doing. This is a screening signal, not a diagnosis.
flag_assessment.some_differ.headline: Some clips differ from the age reference
flag_assessment.unreliable.detail: Too many clips fell below the quality gate. Seat the child again and repeat. This is a screening signal, not a diagnosis.
flag_assessment.unreliable.headline: Recheck — looking time was unreliable
param.ageBands.help: The age bands used to group sessions and norms.
param.ageBands.label: Age bands
param.aoi.dwellCapMs.help: Longest time one sample can add to a dwell total.
param.aoi.dwellCapMs.label: Dwell cap per sample
param.aoi.marginNorm.help: Grows (positive) or shrinks (negative) every area of interest by this fraction of the screen.
param.aoi.marginNorm.label: Area margin
param.display.bands.eyeDwellPct.monitorM: An eye-region dwell share at or above this value shows as monitor instead of outside the reference.
param.display.bands.eyeDwellPct.okMin.he: An eye-region dwell share at or above this value shows as on target.
param.display.bands.firstEyeLatencyMs.mo: Slower than the on-target limit but faster than this shows as monitor; slower shows outside the reference.
First look at the eyes: monitor limit
param.display.bands.firstEyeLatencyMs.ok: A first look at the eyes faster than this shows as on target.
First look at the eyes: on-target limit
param.display.bands.flatAffect.okMax.hel: A flat-affect score at or below this value shows as expressive.
Highest mouth dwell share inside the reference range.
Lowest mouth dwell share inside the reference range.
param.display.bands.smileIntensityPct.mo: A smile intensity at or above this value shows as monitor instead of outside the reference.
param.display.bands.smileIntensityPct.ok: A smile intensity at or above this value shows as on target.
param.display.bands.smileReactivity.okMi: A smile reactivity index at or above this value shows as responsive.
Below the on-target minimum but at or above this share shows as monitor; below it, outside the reference.
A social-preference share at or above this value shows as on target.
param.display.bands.surprisePct.okMin.he: A share of surprise expressions at or above this value shows as expressive.
param.display.scanpathMaxGapMs.help: The drawn gaze path breaks across a gap between samples longer than this.
param.display.scanpathMaxGapMs.label: Scanpath gap limit
param.flag.atypicalShareForRed.help: Share of atypical clips at which the session is labelled red.
param.flag.atypicalShareForRed.label: Atypical share for red
param.flag.greenFloor.help: Composite score at or above this value is labelled green (analysis label only).
param.flag.greenFloor.label: Green floor
param.flag.lowConfidenceShare.help: Share of low-confidence clips above which the session is labelled unreliable.
param.flag.lowConfidenceShare.label: Low-confidence share
param.flag.yellowFloor.help: Composite score at or above this value, and below the green floor, is labelled yellow.
param.flag.yellowFloor.label: Yellow floor
param.lowConfidenceValidRatio.help: A clip with a valid-sample ratio below this value counts as low confidence.
param.lowConfidenceValidRatio.label: Low-confidence valid ratio
param.metrics.fallbackFrameIntervalSec.h: Frame interval assumed when timestamps are missing.
param.metrics.flatAffectGain.help: Scales the facial-movement signal used for the flat-affect measure.
param.metrics.flatAffectGain.label: Flat affect gain
param.metrics.ivtUnit.help: Whether the fixation threshold is in screen units or degrees.
param.metrics.ivtUnit.label: Fixation velocity unit
param.metrics.ivtVelocityDegPerSec.help: Fixation threshold in degrees per second; used when the unit is degrees.
param.metrics.ivtVelocityDegPerSec.label: Fixation velocity (degrees)
param.metrics.ivtVelocityUnitsPerSec.hel: Gaze speed below which samples count as one fixation (screen units per second).
param.metrics.minFixationDurationSec.hel: Shortest run of slow samples that counts as a fixation.
param.metrics.smileReactivityWindowSec.h: Time after a cue in which a smile counts as a reaction.
param.norms.includeImputed.help: Include norm cells that were filled by interpolation.
param.norms.includeImputed.label: Include imputed norms
param.norms.minN.help: A band with fewer sessions is not reported.
param.norms.minN.label: Minimum sessions per band
param.qualityGate.blinkThreshold.help: Eye-closure level treated as a blink.
param.qualityGate.blinkThreshold.label: Blink threshold
param.qualityGate.maxDistanceCm.help: Farthest face-to-screen distance accepted during capture.
param.qualityGate.maxDistanceCm.label: Maximum distance
param.qualityGate.maxPitchRad.help: Largest up or down head tilt for which a sample is kept.
param.qualityGate.maxPitchRad.label: Maximum head pitch
param.qualityGate.maxYawRad.help: Largest sideways head turn for which a sample is kept.
param.qualityGate.maxYawRad.label: Maximum head yaw
param.qualityGate.minConfidence.help: Samples below this tracker confidence are dropped.
param.qualityGate.minConfidence.label: Minimum tracking confidence
param.qualityGate.minDistanceCm.help: Closest face-to-screen distance accepted during capture.
param.qualityGate.minDistanceCm.label: Minimum distance
param.review.lowQualityValidRatio.help: Sessions with a valid-sample ratio below this value are queued for quality review.
param.review.lowQualityValidRatio.label: Low-quality valid ratio
param.sessionQuality.acceptableMinValidR: Sessions below the optimal ratio with at least this share of valid frames are stored as acceptable; below it, degraded.
param.sessionQuality.optimalMinValidRati: Sessions with at least this share of valid frames are stored as optimal quality.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.autoSe: Pick the best-fitting calibration model per session.
Largest error still rated fair after calibration.
Largest error still rated good after calibration.
Largest error still rated poor after calibration.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.collec: Time over which samples are collected at each calibration target.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.defaul: Mapping model used when automatic selection is off.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.eligib: Extra usable points a complex model needs beyond its minimum.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.layout: Normalised target positions of the five-point calibration.
Normalised target positions of the nine-point calibration.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.madRej: Samples farther than this many median deviations from the target centre are rejected.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.maxCon: Largest numerical condition of the fit; above it the fit is rejected as unstable.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.maxRet: How often a failed calibration target is repeated.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.maxTar: Longest wait for a calibration target before it is skipped.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.minImp: Accuracy gain needed before a more complex model replaces the default.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.minSam: Samples needed at a calibration target for it to count.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.minUsa: Calibration points needed for a calibration to be accepted.
param.trackingQuality.calibration.settle: Wait after a target appears before samples are collected.
param.trackingQuality.confidence.distanc: Farthest distance at which confidence is not reduced.
Nearest distance at which confidence is not reduced.
param.trackingQuality.confidence.eyeOpen: Eye openness at or above which confidence is not reduced.
param.trackingQuality.confidence.headSpe: Head speed up to which confidence is not reduced.
param.trackingQuality.confidence.maxHead: Head speed at which confidence falls to zero.
param.trackingQuality.confidence.poseCom: Share of the pose range in which confidence is not reduced.
param.trackingQuality.confidence.poseShi: Pose change up to which confidence is not reduced.
Normalised target positions of the drift check.
param.trackingQuality.drift.collectMs.he: Time over which samples are collected at each drift target.
param.trackingQuality.drift.hardDeg.help: Drift above which the session tracking is marked unusable.
param.trackingQuality.drift.minSamples.h: Samples needed for a drift check to count.
param.trackingQuality.drift.settleMs.hel: Wait after a drift target appears before samples are collected.
param.trackingQuality.drift.warnConsecut: Warnings in a row that trigger a recalibration.
param.trackingQuality.drift.warnDeg.help: Drift above which a warning is recorded.
param.trackingQuality.filter.beta.help: How strongly smoothing relaxes at higher gaze speed.
param.trackingQuality.filter.beta.label: Filter speed coefficient
param.trackingQuality.filter.dCutoffHz.h: Cutoff of the speed estimate used by the filter.
param.trackingQuality.filter.minCutoffHz: Smoothing at rest; lower values smooth more.
param.trackingQuality.gapFill.lossInterv: Longest single loss interval counted towards data loss.
param.trackingQuality.gapFill.maxDeg.hel: Largest gaze movement across a gap that is still filled.
param.trackingQuality.gapFill.maxMs.help: Longest tracking gap that is filled by interpolation.
param.trackingQuality.provisional.help: Marks the tracking-quality thresholds as provisional until they are validated.
param.trackingQuality.provisional.label: Tracking thresholds provisional
param.trackingQuality.recalibration.maxC: A calibration older than this is repeated.
param.trackingQuality.recalibration.maxR: Most recalibrations allowed in one battery of clips.
Most recalibrations allowed in one session.
param.trackingQuality.recalibration.pose: Change in head angle that asks for a new calibration.
Change in face distance that asks for a new calibration.
Time window over which pose changes are measured.
param.trackingQuality.scoring.aoiResolut: Scales the gaze error that is allowed around an area of interest.
param.trackingQuality.scoring.ivtVelocit: Velocity threshold in degrees per second used to detect fixations.
param.trackingQuality.scoring.maxAccurac: Sessions with a larger measured error are not scored.
param.trackingQuality.trackState.blinkRe: Time after a blink before the eye counts as tracked again.
param.trackingQuality.trackState.maxEyeS: Eye speeds above this are treated as tracking errors.
param.trackingQuality.trackState.offscre: Margin beyond the screen edge before gaze counts as off-screen.
param.trackingQuality.validation.benchLa: Normalised target positions of the 13-point bench validation.
param.trackingQuality.validation.collect: Time over which samples are collected at each validation target.
Normalised target positions of the accuracy validation.
param.trackingQuality.validation.maxAccu: Measured error above which the validation fails.
param.trackingQuality.validation.minSamp: Samples needed at a validation target for it to count.
param.trackingQuality.validation.minTarg: Validation targets that must be measured for a validation to count.
param.trackingQuality.validation.settleM: Wait after a validation target appears before samples are collected.
param.trackingQuality.validation.warnAcc: Measured error above which a warning is recorded.
param.trackingQuality.verdict.accuracyBa: Largest error rated fair in the tracking verdict.
Largest error rated good in the tracking verdict.
Largest error rated poor in the tracking verdict.
param.trackingQuality.verdict.fairAboveD: Data loss above which tracking is rated fair at best.
param.trackingQuality.verdict.poorAboveD: Data loss above which tracking is rated poor.
param.trackingQuality.verdict.unusableBe: Sessions with a lower valid-sample ratio are rated unusable.
